headline: Clean: the KB has no travel-notification procedure, so the agent should say so and transfer under kb_search_unsuccessful_customer_requests_transfer when the customer asks.
solution_check: Searched all 698 docs for travel notifications/notices/alerts: some docs mention them in passing (gold_rewards_card_004 "Enable travel notifications if your risk controls require it", diamond_elite_card_008 "Enable travel alerts", platinum_rewards_card_003 "Enable transaction and international use alerts"), but none gives a procedure, form or channel. The agent should say it has no documented process. The customer then asks for a human, which matches the Tier 2 code kb_search_unsuccessful_customer_requests_transfer exactly; no Tier 1 code applies.
prior_note: Prior verdict was clean and still holds.
notes: Grading-model check (snapshot v1.0.1): confirmed _derive_read_log_allowlist, parse_int=float in call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool, apply_for_credit_card casts annual_income to float, Action.compare_with_tool_call ignores requestor, fixed clock get_now()=2025-11-14 03:40:00. Risk, not a defect: an agent that passes on the passing KB tips, or the generic support number in credit_cards_(general)_023 ("1-800-RHO-BANK"), may lead the user simulator to treat that as instructions (scenario rule 4 mentions phone numbers) and end without a transfer.
